title: Worth it for the flights alone
body: ANC is unreal at 30,000 feet. I charge them Sunday night and they last the whole commuting week.

title: Great sound, bit heavy
body: No complaints about the sound. After three hours I can feel them on the top of my head though.

title: Open office: solved
body: Silences everything. I have stopped hearing the sales team.

title: Stayed in through sprints
body: Never fell out once. Case fits in a running short pocket.

title: Mic is the weak point
body: Music is great. On calls people keep asking if I am in a tunnel.

title: Took it to the beach, survived
body: Sand, a wave, and a full afternoon of abuse. Still going. The bass caught everyone off guard.

title: Fills the whole garden
body: Loud and clear at half volume. Pairing the second one took about ten seconds.

title: Listeners noticed immediately
body: Three people emailed to ask what I had changed. Monitoring through the mic is the feature I did not know I needed.

title: Picks up everything, including my typing
body: Had to buy a boom arm because it hears the desk. Voice sounds rich once you sort that out.

title: My dad's records, finally
body: Twenty year old vinyl and it sounds better than I remember. The built-in preamp saved me another purchase.

title: Almost perfect
body: Tracking is accurate and the screen is lovely. Why is the charger not USB-C in 2026.

title: Seven days is real
body: Not marketing. I charge it on Sunday and forget about it.

title: GPS locks fast
body: Ran it against a measured track and the pace was within a couple of seconds. Good enough.

title: Does most of what a $300 watch does
body: For the money there is nothing to complain about.

title: Cannot read it outside
body: Fine indoors. In direct sun at full brightness I am guessing at the numbers.

title: The readiness score is not nonsense
body: It matches how I actually feel, which surprised me. Forgot I was wearing it by the second day.

title: Accurate and it looks like jewellery
body: Within a few minutes of my lab sleep tracker. Order the sizing kit, do not guess.

title: Three weeks in Patagonia
body: Solar kept it alive the whole trip. The altimeter got us down in a whiteout.

title: Six months, no drift
body: Hall-effect sticks still feel like day one after a lot of ranked.

title: Paddles need a week
body: Build quality is excellent. I hit the back paddles by accident for the first week and blamed the game.

title: Sounds right out of the box
body: Gasket mount and lubed linears. I did not have to open it, which is a first.

title: My colleagues hate it
body: I love it. They do not. Get the silent switches if you sit near people.

title: Twenty grams lighter than my old one
body: Flicks are noticeably faster. Whether that is the mouse or placebo I cannot say, but my aim improved.

title: Passthrough is good enough to read my phone
body: Pancake lenses kill the screen-door effect completely. First headset I have used for more than an hour.

title: Brilliant hardware, wrong person
body: None of this is the headset's fault. Twenty minutes in and I am queasy. Try one before you spend this much.

title: Sanwa parts, obviously
body: Feels like the cabinet I grew up on. Landed my first clean combo streak the same evening.

title: No more alt-tabbing mid-game
body: Scene switching without leaving the game is the whole reason I bought it. Plugin setup took an evening.

title: Bedtime is easier now
body: Sunset dimming did more for my kids' routine than anything else I have tried. Setup was five minutes.

title: Good for renters
body: Full smart lighting without touching a single wire. Colours are properly vivid, not washed out.

title: Paid for itself already
body: Energy bill down 18% over two months. And the display is genuinely nice to look at.

title: No subscription
body: On-device detection means alerts without a monthly fee. Night footage is in colour and actually usable.

title: Caught the guy
body: Person detection pinged me as he walked up the path. The footage was clear enough for the police report.

title: This is how it starts
body: Bought two for the coffee maker. Now the whole house runs on schedules. Not sure how that happened.

title: My fridge is a subscription
body: Turns out the old fridge costs more per month than Netflix. Replacing it now.

title: 99 cents
body: My charging cable no longer falls behind the desk. Best money-to-annoyance ratio I have found.

title: It is a clip. It is a good clip.
body: Hard to write a paragraph about a cable clip, but here we are. It sticks. It holds. Four stars.

title: One cable and done
body: Two 4K monitors, ethernet and charging through one port. Gets warm under load but nothing alarming.

title: Saved a work trip
body: Turned a hotel TV into a second screen. The aluminium shell has been through my backpack all year.

title: Lovely first deck
body: Bluetooth out to the kitchen speaker is a ridiculous thing to do and I do it daily. Dust cover feels cheap.

title: Light enough to save my wrist
body: Long edits used to end in wrist pain. They do not now. Battery claim holds up.
